jsonld.description: Conditional row archiving and sheet performance optimizer for Google Sheets: local-first Apps Script execution, atomic LockService transfers, and zero SaaS rent.
featureList: Rule-based row archiving (equals, contains, older than X days, empty)
Live pre-scan preview showing exact matching row counts and sample data
Automatic archive tab creation with copied header column schemas
Atomic LockService mutex protection preventing row index corruption
100% in-account execution via non-sensitive spreadsheets.currentonly scope
One-time lifetime license — zero recurring subscriptions
